policy_semantics.activate_at_first_legal_search: Choose the earliest legal chain window that can negate a search.
policy_semantics.activate_after_first_search: Wait until the first search resolves, then activate if legal.
policy_semantics.activate_on_Fallen_or_Ecclesia: Choose a legal Fallen or Ecclesia monster-effect window; search evaluates both targets.

notes: The engine must still verify that each policy has a legal timing window in the exact replay.
A configured interruption is not evidence that the opponent actually activated it.
